## Problem and scope

Describe one player/host outcome and explicit non-goals.

## Evidence and decision

Local code/tests inspected:
External research, only if needed (URL + commit/version + files/behavior + license + relevant limitation):
Selected approach and why research is sufficient:
If blocked, the specific unanswered question and bounded next investigation:

## Specification

- [ ] Observable acceptance checks and relevant failure cases are stated.
- [ ] Permissions, persistence and API/WebSocket changes are described when affected.

## Implementation

Describe the original behavior delivered. List any intentional code/dependency reuse and attribution, or state none.

## Verification

Record exact commands and actual outcomes; identify unrun checks and blockers.
For runtime changes: typecheck, relevant tests, build and the affected browser/game flow.
For documentation-only changes: content, links and diff checks.

- [ ] Acceptance checks passed, with evidence above.
- [ ] Scope stayed focused; unrelated ideas are deferred.

## Delivery status

State what has actually happened: proposed, reviewed, merged, deployed, production-verified.
Do not infer deployment from a merge. Resolve acceptance blockers before moving to the next feature, or explicitly record the incomplete state and re-prioritization.
